Kavya Rao: Quick runtime roadmap follow-up thread. Capturing the top Qs from today's session.
Jin Park: What exact perf baseline should teams use for p95 targets? Need to sync perf infra.
Kavya Rao: Baseline: 8k context, avg request 512 tokens, default quantized path (int8). Hosted p95 goal 120ms, dedicated SLA 100ms p95.
Maya Singh: Does that baseline include cache warmup? Some of our tests ran cold and looked worse.
Kavya Rao: Targets assume steady-state (warm cache). We'll add a separate cold-start baseline in docs.
Otis Bell: On batching heuristics: will latency_budget_ms be configurable per-route?
Kavya Rao: Yes. Default runtime uses latency-first (stop on latency_budget or max_batch). Per-route override allows throughput mode for tolerant routes.
Jin Park: Can we get a short config example to copy into our local runner?
Kavya Rao: I'll post a minimal YAML example here by EOD.
sre-oncall: Ops note: KV eviction spikes caused a tail for one customer yesterday. Any immediate rollback plan?
Otis Bell: Short-term: increase tenant TTL and reduce global eviction aggressiveness. Long-term: LRU+protected recent prefixes. Engineering to publish algorithm and metric impacts.
Maya Singh: We also need kernel-level tracing (matmul/attn/softmax) surfaced in Console; current spans too coarse.
Kavya Rao: Runtime will add kernel_name and kernel_ms spans behind a feature flag next sprint.
deploy-bot: canary queued: runtime/kernel-vector-proto -> canary group gamma (job 9201)
sre-oncall: tagging release-war-room to watch p95/p99 during canary.
Kavya Rao: Actions: Jin will sync perf infra, Otis to handle eviction mitigation, Runtime to add kernel spans, Kavya to post config snippet and rollout checklist. Ping here for updates.
Jin Park: I'll DM if I don't see the config by EOD.
Maya Singh: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
